jobs.title: Conservation Ranger, National Parks and Wildlife Service
jobs.employer: NPWS (Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage)
jobs.location: Nationwide, Republic of Ireland (includes Dublin, Cork, Galway)
requirements: Experience in wildlife management or nature conservation (volunteering and placements count)
Strong interest in wildlife and nature conservation
Good IT and report writing skills
Full driving licence (a UK licence must be exchanged if living in Ireland)
jobs.about: Field-based ranger doing species and habitat monitoring, conservation management, Wildlife Acts work and public engagement.
jobs.how_to_apply: Online application on publicjobs.ie by 3pm, 19 November

jobs.title: Graduate Environmental Scientist / Ecologist (2027 start)
requirements: Degree (Level 7 or higher) in ecology, environmental science or similar
Right to live and work in the Republic of Ireland
jobs.about: Graduate cohort supporting ecology and environmental work on water, energy and infrastructure projects, starting June to September 2027.
jobs.how_to_apply: Online via Stantec careers (check the listing details there)

jobs.title: Trainee (Conservation), Brooke Park
requirements: No previous experience needed
Horticulture or plant-growing experience helpful
Experience with volunteers and the public helpful
jobs.about: Paid traineeship leading volunteers on community gardens and habitat work on bogs, woodlands and dunes.
jobs.how_to_apply: Online on the TCV vacancy page, quoting ID357

jobs.title: Trainee (Conservation), Acorn Farm
requirements: No previous experience needed
Say how the role advances your career
Plant or vegetable growing experience helpful
jobs.about: Paid traineeship helping open a sustainable food-growing site, then running community learning and volunteer days in 2027.
jobs.how_to_apply: Online on the TCV vacancy page, quoting ID358

jobs.title: Community Engagement Coordinator
jobs.contract: Permanent (subject to funding), 30 hours over 4 days
requirements: Degree, or 3 years' relevant experience
2 years' project coordination and 1 year supervising staff
Excel, data collection and reporting
Full driving licence and access to transport
jobs.about: Plans and runs the charity's community environmental programmes and events, coordinating field officers and reporting on results.
jobs.how_to_apply: CV via Charity Jobs NI; interviews 17 November in Belfast

jobs.title: Field Ornithologist
jobs.location: Dublin, with surveys across the Midlands
requirements: Degree in ecology, zoology, environmental science or similar
Strong Irish bird identification and field skills
Full driving licence
Dawn and dusk surveys, sometimes in remote locations
jobs.about: Bird surveys for renewable energy, transport and development impact assessments, with a company vehicle.
jobs.how_to_apply: Through Gaia Talent on GreenJobs.ie, quoting ref ISMKOFO23/10

jobs.title: Environmental Consultant
requirements: Degree in environmental science or similar
1 to 2 years in the environmental sector
Strong report writing and attention to detail
jobs.about: Supports environmental impact assessment, licensing and compliance work, interpreting environmental data and joining fieldwork.
jobs.how_to_apply: Through Gaia Talent on GreenJobs.ie, quoting ref 2210DD

jobs.title: Biodiversity Consultant / Project Coordinator
requirements: Genuine interest in nature
Strong organisation and attention to detail
Clear writing; training and mentoring provided
jobs.about: Runs smaller projects and prepares proposals for a small biodiversity consultancy, supporting its directors.
jobs.how_to_apply: Two-page CV and short covering letter by email (link on the CIEEM listing)

jobs.title: Environmental Coordinator
requirements: Degree
IT skills and working independently to deadlines
Treatment plant experience helpful, full training given
jobs.about: Monitors a wastewater treatment plant: daily checks and records, troubleshooting and maintenance.
jobs.how_to_apply: Through Gaia Talent on GreenJobs.ie, quoting ref 2210X

jobs.title: Individual Giving Officer (Retention and Mid-Value)
requirements: Experience in individual giving or donor retention
Analysing campaign and donor data
Interest in nature conservation
jobs.about: Builds a supporter retention programme and reports on donor data for a global bird conservation charity.
jobs.how_to_apply: Via the recruiter link on CharityJob
